method: Linux Chromium production preview, healthy desktop CPU/storage; 20 ms main-thread heartbeat during real file import and durable commit; exact stored command comparison and reload

boundedLegacy.method: Node import of a valid format-1 file at the command-count limit; no browser rendering claim

sameBuildReplayComparison.method: Single same-build Node trial, identical parsed commands and initial state; no physical-device or population claim

limits: Owned replay removes per-command whole-state copies; validation, checksums, serialization and cloning still cost time. Serialization, cloning and rendering still use the main thread. The 20,000-command result is Node format-1 import only, not browser rendering, durable format-2 migration or physical-device acceptance. Large snapshot exports may exceed the existing 2 MiB limit. Validation has a 20-second per-request deadline; oversized/incompatible data is rejected without writes.
